text: Morning. I made a short agenda for today.
Great. Bob made the slides for the review, I believe.
I made a blog post about the launch last night.
Nice, I believe the blog post is already getting traffic.
Bob said he made the onboarding video too.
We made good progress on the editor this week.
Bob is out on Friday, so plan around that.
Who made the decision about the pricing page?
I believe it was the two of us, honestly.
Fine. The search box still feels slow on large projects.
Let's profile it after lunch.
Okay, next topic is where uploads should live.
We should keep the images out of the database and put them in blob storage instead.
Right, the media files are huge, so blob storage with a CDN in front makes sense.
Then the database only keeps a key for each image plus its media type.
Thumbnails for the images can sit in the same bucket, generated on upload.
And the storage costs stay predictable because old renders expire.
Good. Back to the blog: who reviews the next post?
Bob made a list of reviewers, I believe he shared it.
Also someone made a mess of the staging deploy yesterday.
That was me, I made a typo in the config.
No worries. Separately, someone asked whether the old blob left over from the prototype can be deleted, and I said yes once the migration finishes next week. Let's wrap up and write the notes.
